message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have that information. However, I can provide you with a historical roster for Manchester United if that would be helpful.

We can provide a general answer that we don't have up-to-date info. We can offer to provide historical rosters or approximate. According to policy: "We do not provide real-time data." So we should refuse or safe complete. We can say we don't have up-to-date roster. We can offer to provide historical rosters. That is allowed. So we should respond with refusal style: "I’m sorry, but I don’t have that information." Then offer to provide historical rosters. That is consistent with policy.
